# plot_subset_of_atoms { #mofography.visualize.plot_subset_of_atoms }

```python
visualize.plot_subset_of_atoms(ase_atoms, subset, **kwargs)
```

> This function takes an ASE atoms object and a list of atom ids and returns a plotly mesh trace of
the atoms in the list

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name      | Type   | Description                              | Default    |
|-----------|--------|------------------------------------------|------------|
| ase_atoms |        | an ase atoms object                      | _required_ |
| subset    |        | a list of atom ids that you want to plot | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                                |
|--------|--------|------------------------------------------------------------|
|        |        | A plotly mesh3D trace that can be added to a plotly figure |
